description: Save a new skill of your own: a routine the agent can run for you on your connected accounts. Private to you. Takes the title, the situation it is for, what it produces, the skill file (markdown, the same shape as a published skill), the tools it uses, and whether it runs on a single account or multiple. Answers with the slug and version.

situation.description: The problem, in your words. Optional.

source.description: The skill file itself, markdown with frontmatter.

title.description: Query-shaped, like a published skill's title.

tools.description: The tools it uses, by name.

name: skills_create
